title: Brand deal negotiation

memories.content: Never promotes supplements without a lab report

topics.ask: A protein brand offers ₹15,000 for one reel and two stories. My minimum is ₹25,000 for a reel.
topics.answer: Reply with your rate and a package: one reel for ₹25,000, or a reel plus two stories for ₹32,000. Ask for their usage terms (how long they can use the content, whether in ads) because ad usage should cost extra. Since this is a supplement, ask for the lab test report before agreeing, as per your rule.

topics.ask: They sent a lab report and agreed to ₹25,000 for the reel only. Usage: 3 months on their page.
topics.answer: Good. Put it in writing: deliverable one reel, posting date, one round of changes, content usage on their own page for 3 months, no paid ads unless separately agreed, payment ₹25,000 within 15 days of posting. Keep the lab report with the agreement and mark the post as a paid partnership.

Reel ₹25,000; reel plus two stories ₹32,000; story set of three ₹12,000; usage in paid ads billed separately per month; exclusivity in a category billed separately. Note that supplements need a lab report.

ask: Summarise the protein brand deal terms and my rate card.
